summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage the capabilities of large-scale pretrained video diffusion models to jointly predict future observations and actions, inheriting rich visual and physical priors from internet-scale video. This has made them a promising paradigm for robot policy learning, yet the prevailing models operate exclusively on RGB observations and do not leverage 3D information. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Spatially Aware World Action Model (SA-WAM), which repurposes a pretrained video model for joint action, RGB, and depth prediction, enabling 3D-aware world modeling and action prediction within a single diffusion backbone. We use a nonlinear encoding that maps the unbounded depth signal into the bounded input domain expected by the frozen VAE tokenizer. This allows us to reuse the tokenizer without 3D-specific fine-tuning, incorporating geometric information without sacrificing the pretrained priors. SA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboCasa and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, while simultaneously improving future-state predictions. Furthermore, SA-WAM outperforms strong baselines in real-world evaluation using a UR5 robotic arm, with strong gains in randomized environments. We analyze the correlation between world model prediction quality and rollout success, providing insights into WAM performance and avenues for its improvement.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）利用大规模预训练视频扩散模型的能力，联合预测未来观测结果与动作，继承了互联网规模视频中丰富的视觉与物理先验知识。这使其成为机器人策略学习的一种有前景范式，但现有模型仅基于RGB观测数据运行，并未利用三维信息。为弥补这一不足，我们提出空间感知世界行动模型（SA-WAM），该模型重新利用预训练视频模型实现联合动作、RGB与深度预测，在单一扩散主干中实现三维感知的世界建模与动作预测。我们采用非线性编码将无界深度信号映射至冻结VAE分词器的有界输入域，从而无需针对三维数据进行微调即可复用该分词器，在保留预训练先验知识的同时融入几何信息。SA-WAM在RoboCasa和LIBERO-Plus基准测试中取得了最优结果，同时改善了未来状态预测性能。此外，在采用UR5机械臂的真实世界评估中，SA-WAM超越强基线方法，并在随机化环境中展现出显著优势。我们分析了世界模型预测质量与部署成功之间的相关性，为理解WAM性能及改进方向提供了洞见。
tldr: SA-WAM extends world action models by incorporating 3D geometric depth information via a nonlinear encoding into a frozen VAE tokenizer, enabling joint RGB-depth-action prediction for improved robot policy learning on benchmarks and real-world robotic arms.
tldr_zh: SA-WAM 通过非线性编码将深度信息注入冻结的 VAE 分词器，扩展了世界动作模型以支持 3D 几何感知，实现了 RGB-深度-动作联合预测，在机器人基准和真实机械臂上提升了策略性能。

title: CrashDiffuser: VLM-Guided Collision Intent Reasoning for Fine-Grained Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation
summary: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for evaluating autonomous driving systems. However, existing generators primarily focus on inducing collisions and offer limited control over where contact occurs on the target vehicle. In this paper, we study fine-grained safety-critical scenario generation, where success requires both a target collision and a specified head, rear, or side contact region. We propose CrashDiffuser, a closed-loop VLM-guided diffusion framework that decouples semantic collision reasoning from continuous trajectory synthesis through a hierarchical collision-intent interface derived from the requested target contact region. At initialization, the VLM extracts reusable scene-level context; at each replanning step, it predicts a structured action tuple describing speed change, turning behavior, and collision stage. This intent conditions a diffusion model to generate executable adversarial trajectories, while collision-guided sampling, candidate selection, and short-horizon replanning adapt generation to the target vehicle's evolving behavior. On WOMD-derived closed-loop scenarios, CrashDiffuser achieves a target-collision rate of 50.33% in a single attempt and 67.98% after three attempts, together with a contact-region control success rate of 40.05% and competitive trajectory naturalness. Component ablations further support the proposed design.
summary_zh: 生成安全关键场景对于评估自动驾驶系统至关重要。然而，现有生成器主要侧重于诱发碰撞，且对目标车辆接触位置的控制能力有限。本文研究细粒度安全关键场景生成，其成功要求同时实现目标碰撞与指定的车头、车尾或侧面接触区域。我们提出CrashDiffuser，一种闭环VLM引导的扩散框架，通过基于请求目标接触区域的分层碰撞意图接口，将语义碰撞推理与连续轨迹生成解耦。初始化时，VLM提取可复用的场景级上下文；在每个重规划步骤中，它预测描述速度变化、转向行为及碰撞阶段的结构化动作元组。该意图引导扩散模型生成可执行的对抗性轨迹，同时碰撞引导采样、候选选择及短视界重规划使生成过程自适应目标车辆的动态行为。在基于WOMD的闭环场景中，CrashDiffuser首次尝试的目标碰撞率达50.33%，三次尝试后提升至67.98%，同时接触区域控制成功率达40.05%，轨迹自然度具有竞争力。组件消融实验进一步验证了所提设计方案的有效性。
tldr: CrashDiffuser is a closed-loop VLM-guided diffusion framework for fine-grained safety-critical traffic scenario generation, enabling control over specific collision contact regions (head, rear, side) on a target vehicle in autonomous driving simulations.
tldr_zh: CrashDiffuser 是一个闭环的 VLM 引导扩散框架，用于生成细粒度的安全关键交通场景，能够在自动驾驶仿真中控制目标车辆上的特定碰撞接触区域（头部、尾部、侧面）。

title: DiffuSearch: How Hybrid Trajectory Planning Benefits from Aligned Objectives in Diffusion and Action Space
summary: In trajectory planning for autonomous driving, hybrid planning architectures are often realized as a collection of disparate modules, each with its own objectives. This lack of a unifying principle can lead to inconsistencies between the initial and refined trajectory, resulting in suboptimal behavior. We address this by introducing DiffuSearch, a novel hybrid planner that uses a unified set of objectives across generation and refinement. Our model encourages all components to follow the same shared driving goals: collision avoidance, drivable area compliance, comfort, and progress. DiffuSearch employs a two-stage architecture. First, a guided diffusion model generates a scene-consistent, joint trajectory prediction, using our driving objectives as differentiable guidance functions to implicitly steer the denoising process. Second, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) in a discretized action space performs an explicit, local refinement of this proposal, leveraging the same driving objectives as its reward function. This synergistic design leverages the diffusion model's strength in finding scene-consistent solutions combined with the explainable, constraint-aware refinement of MCTS. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan reactive closed-loop benchmarks demonstrate that DiffuSearch achieves strong and often state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing collisions and improving comfort, particularly in complex, interactive scenarios. Our ablation studies indicate that MCTS refinement is the main mechanism behind the gains, while sharing objectives between implicit guidance and explicit search provides further consistent improvements.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶轨迹规划中，混合规划架构通常由一组各自具有特定目标的独立模块构成。这种统一原则的缺失可能导致初始轨迹与精化轨迹之间存在不一致，进而产生次优行为。我们通过提出DiffuSearch来解决这一问题，该新型混合规划器在轨迹生成与精化阶段采用统一的目标集。我们的模型促使所有组件遵循相同的共享驾驶目标：避撞、可行驶区域合规性、舒适性以及行进效率。DiffuSearch采用两阶段架构：首先，引导扩散模型生成场景一致、联合轨迹预测，将驾驶目标作为可微引导函数隐式调控去噪过程；其次，在离散动作空间中运用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）对该提案进行显式的局部精化，并以同样的驾驶目标作为奖励函数。这种协同设计充分发挥了扩散模型寻找场景一致解的优势，同时结合了MCTS可解释、约束感知的精化能力。在nuPlan和interPlan反应式闭环基准上的实验表明，DiffuSearch实现了强劲且常为最先进的性能，显著减少碰撞并提升舒适性，尤其在复杂交互场景中。我们的消融研究表明，MCTS精化是性能提升的主要机制，而隐式引导与显式搜索之间共享目标则带来进一步的一致性改进。
tldr: DiffuSearch is a hybrid trajectory planner for autonomous driving that unifies objectives across a diffusion-based trajectory generator and a Monte Carlo Tree Search refiner, achieving strong closed-loop performance on nuPlan and interPlan benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DiffuSearch是一种用于自动驾驶的混合轨迹规划器，将扩散模型轨迹生成器和蒙特卡洛树搜索细化器的目标统一，在nuPlan和interPlan闭环基准上取得了优异性能。

title: FOCUS: Foot Observation Confidence for Robust Humanoid Proprioceptive Odometry
summary: Foot forward kinematics (FK) is widely used to improve proprioceptive legged odometry by providing reliable velocity constraints during foot support. Existing contact-aided estimators generally rely on binary contact decisions to determine whether the FK measurements of an entire foot should be trusted. However, contact does not necessarily imply FK reliability. Dynamic locomotion often involves partial support, toe dragging, and foot slip, causing binary contact decisions to accumulate significant drift over long trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose FOCUS (Foot Observation Confidence from Unannotated Simulation), which predicts a continuous FK reliability weight for each foot instead of estimating binary foot contact. Rather than replacing the model-based estimator, the predicted reliability weights are used to blend FK velocity observations with IMU-propagated body velocity and to adapt the observation covariance of an extended Kalman filter (EKF), enabling smooth reliability-aware fusion without hard contact switching. The network is trained from automatically generated simulation signals using an FK-weighted velocity consistency loss with lightweight simulator-contact regularization, without manually annotated continuous FK-reliability labels. The deployed model relies only on IMU and joint kinematic measurements, making it suitable for hardware platforms with unreliable torque sensing. Experiments demonstrate that FOCUS reduces absolute trajectory error (ATE) by 83.7% on simulated walking episodes, preserves simulated dynamic-motion fidelity in motion scale and spectral energy, reduces ATE by 70.8% across 19 real walking segments, and reduces mean ATE by 42.7% across four real dynamic-motion routines.
summary_zh: 足部正运动学（FK）被广泛应用于提升本体感觉腿式里程计，通过在足部支撑阶段提供可靠的速度约束来改善估计精度。现有的接触辅助估计器通常依赖二值化接触判断来决定是否信任整个足部的FK测量值。然而，足部接触并不必然意味着FK的可靠性。动态运动常伴随部分支撑、拖趾及足底打滑等情况，导致二值化接触判断在长轨迹中累积显著漂移。为解决这一局限，我们提出FOCUS（基于无标注仿真数据的足部观测置信度预测）方法，为每个足部预测连续的FK可靠性权重，而非估计二值化足部接触。该方法并非替代基于模型的估计器，而是利用预测的可靠性权重将FK速度观测与IMU传播的机体速度进行融合，并自适应调整扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的观测协方差，从而在不采用硬接触切换的情况下实现平滑的可靠性感知融合。网络通过自动生成的仿真信号进行训练，采用FK加权速度一致性损失并辅以轻量级仿真器接触正则化，无需人工标注的连续FK可靠性标签。部署模型仅依赖IMU和关节运动学测量，适用于缺乏可靠力矩传感的硬件平台。实验表明，在仿真行走场景中，FOCUS将绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低83.7%，在运动尺度和频谱能量上保持仿真动态运动保真度；在19段真实行走数据中ATE降低70.8%；在四类真实动态运动流程中平均ATE降低42.7%。
tldr: FOCUS uses a neural network trained from simulation to predict continuous foot observation reliability weights, replacing binary contact detection, and fuses them with an EKF to greatly reduce drift in humanoid proprioceptive odometry.
tldr_zh: FOCUS 利用仿真训练的神经网络预测连续足部观测可靠性权重，替代二元接触检测，并与 EKF 融合，大幅降低人形机器人本体感知里程计的漂移。

title: Modeling What Changes: Sparse, Residual World Models for Object-Centric Manipulation
summary: Monolithic world models predict the entire next state at every step, spending capacity re-predicting the static majority of a scene and injecting error into it. We ask whether explicitly modeling change (a per-object change gate plus a residual delta head that perturbs only the objects the gate flags) is a more effective and interpretable bias for physical prediction and control. On a MuJoCo tabletop pushing benchmark scaling from 3 to 8 objects, the sparse/residual model predicts next-state poses 2.5 to 4.6 times more accurately than a dense multilayer perceptron at 8.6 to 11.1 times fewer parameters, sustains change-detection F1 of 0.80 to 0.87 where the dense baseline is degenerate, transfers across object counts with zero retraining (99.4 percent F1 retention), and reaches about 90 percent of its full-data accuracy with a quarter of the data. In autoregressive rollout it compounds far less error, hugging the no-motion floor while the dense model drifts. Finally, inside a sampling-based planner, prediction-only models fail (though a true-simulator oracle solves the task with the identical planner, confirming the planner is sound), but once featurized and trained for the states a planner visits, the sparse model begins to plan (0.23 plus or minus 0.06 success over three seeds) while the dense monolith stays at zero at every seed. Modeling what changes, rather than re-predicting the whole world, is a simple, effective bias for object-centric physical AI; code, data generators, and all checkpoints will be released upon publication.
summary_zh: 整体世界模型在每一步都预测完整的下一状态，将计算资源浪费在重复预测场景中大部分静态内容上，并因此引入误差。我们提出疑问：明确对变化进行建模（即每个物体的变化门控机制，以及仅对门控标记的物体施加扰动的残差增量预测头）是否能成为物理预测与控制中更有效且更具可解释性的归纳偏置？在从3个物体扩展到8个物体的MuJoCo桌面推搡基准测试中，稀疏残差模型对下一状态位姿的预测精度比密集多层感知机高2.5至4.6倍，参数量减少8.6至11.1倍，变化检测F1分数维持在0.80至0.87（而密集基线模型已完全退化），能在零重训练条件下跨物体数量迁移（F1保留率达99.4%），且仅用四分之一数据即可达到全数据精度的约90%。在自回归推演中，该模型累积误差显著更小，能紧贴无运动基准线，而密集模型则产生漂移。最后，在基于采样的规划器中，纯预测模型均失败（尽管基于真实模拟器的理想模型使用相同规划器可成功完成任务，证实规划器本身无误），但一旦对规划器访问的状态进行特征化并训练后，稀疏模型开始具备规划能力（三个种子上的成功率为0.23±0.06），而密集整体模型在所有种子上的成功率均为零。对变化进行建模，而非重复预测整个世界，是面向以物体为中心的物理AI的一种简单有效的归纳偏置；相关代码、数据生成器及所有检查点将在论文发表后公开。
tldr: This paper proposes sparse residual world models that explicitly model changes in object-centric scenes, achieving higher accuracy, better data efficiency, and zero-shot transfer in tabletop pushing tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出稀疏残差世界模型，显式建模物体中心场景中的变化，在桌面推动任务中实现更高精度、更好数据效率和零样本迁移。

title: One Demonstration, Many Objects: Generalizing Manipulation via Local Contact Geometry
summary: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered robot hands promises human-level dexterity, but collecting large-scale dexterous robot hand data remains difficult. Learning from human demonstrations has emerged as a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation, providing strong priors on object interaction and contact strategies. Recent sim-to-real RL methods incorporate such priors, but often (i) omit rewards that explicitly incentivize precise contact, yielding weak real-world performance, and/or (ii) generalize poorly to unseen object instances. We propose DemoMimic (Dexterous Motion Mimic), a policy that manipulates objects by focusing on their geometry local to the contact points. Its contact-centric rewards encourage precise contact and improve sim-to-real consistency, yielding a single real-world policy that transfers across objects of varying shape, scale, mass, and friction wherever local contact structure is preserved. Real-world ablations show that DemoMimic achieves 71% success across 16 objects, four tasks, and two robot-hand embodiments, with the smallest sim-to-real drop compared to baselines.
summary_zh: 多指机器人手的灵巧操作有望实现人类级的灵巧性，但大规模采集灵巧机器人手部数据仍存在困难。从人类示范中学习已成为机器人遥操作的一种可扩展替代方案，为物体交互和接触策略提供了强大的先验知识。近期基于仿真的真实迁移强化学习方法虽然引入了此类先验，但往往存在以下问题：（i）缺乏明确激励精确接触的奖励函数，导致在现实中的表现较弱；（ii）对未见过的物体实例泛化能力差。我们提出DemoMimic（灵巧动作模仿）策略，该策略通过聚焦于接触点附近的物体局部几何特征来操控物体。其以接触为中心的奖励机制能够激励精确接触并提升仿真到现实的一致性，从而生成一个单一的现实世界策略，该策略可在保留局部接触结构的不同形状、尺寸、质量及摩擦系数的物体间进行迁移。真实环境消融实验表明，DemoMimic在16个物体、四项任务及两种机器人手部本体上实现了71%的成功率，且与基线方法相比具有最小的仿真到现实性能衰减。
tldr: DemoMimic learns a dexterous manipulation policy from a single human demonstration that generalizes to many objects by focusing on local contact geometry and using contact-centric rewards to improve sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: DemoMimic 通过关注局部接触几何并采用以接触为中心的奖励，从单次人类演示中学到的灵巧操作策略能够泛化到多种物体，并改善了 sim-to-real 的迁移。

title: Designing Versatile Samples for Learned Trajectory Scoring
summary: Many current end-to-end driving policies emit a pool of candidate trajectories and select one, which makes selection a separable component: a scorer can be retrained while the planner, its backbone, and its trajectory generator all stay frozen. However, many strong planners concentrate their proposals around safe mode, providing limited supervision near decision boundaries. In this work, we design a training dataset that provides more informative supervision for the scorer. In particular, we construct two generators that perturb the logged human trajectory along the two axes a vehicle can be displaced: laterally toward the drivable boundary and longitudinally toward a leading vehicle. The designed dataset produces more informative positive and negative samples than the base planner's proposal pool. We attach a transformer-based scorer to two frozen generative planners, DiffusionDrive and MeanFuser, and train it on the NAVSIM navtrain dataset. The results of the experiments show that we achieve 90.1 EPDMS on DiffusionDrive and 90.4 EPDMS on MeanFuser when using ResNet-34, with 0.4 and 0.3 EPDMS respectively, from the designed training dataset.
summary_zh: 许多当前的端到端驾驶策略会生成一组候选轨迹并选择其中一条，这使得轨迹选择成为一个可分离的模块：评分器可以重新训练，而规划器及其骨干网络、轨迹生成器均保持冻结。然而，许多强大的规划器倾向于将轨迹提议集中在安全模态附近，导致决策边界附近的监督信号有限。本研究设计了一种能为评分器提供更丰富监督信息的训练数据集。具体而言，我们构建了两个扰动生成器，它们沿车辆可移动的两个维度对记录的人类轨迹进行扰动：横向朝向可行驶边界，纵向朝向引导车辆。相比基础规划器的轨迹提议池，所设计的数据集能产生更具信息量的正负样本。我们将基于Transformer的评分器附加到两个冻结的生成式规划器（DiffusionDrive和MeanFuser）上，并在NAVSIM navtrain数据集上对其进行训练。实验结果表明，使用ResNet-34时，我们在DiffusionDrive上达到了90.1 EPDMS，在MeanFuser上达到了90.4 EPDMS，其中分别有0.4和0.3 EPDMS的提升来自所设计的训练数据集。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to design a more informative training dataset for trajectory scorers in end-to-end autonomous driving by generating perturbed positive and negative samples, improving scorer training without modifying the frozen planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种为端到端自动驾驶轨迹评分器设计更具信息量的训练数据集的方法，通过生成扰动的正负样本，在冻结规划器的情况下提升评分器训练效果。

title: VIPS: Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Planning Benchmark via Pseudo-Simulation
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving in urban environments requires robust decision-making under partial observability and complex multi-agent interactions. Severe occlusions and dense traffic at intersections limit the perception capability of single-agent systems, motivating recent efforts on Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I) cooperation for perception and planning. However, existing evaluation protocols face a fundamental trade-off: open-loop evaluation fails to capture error accumulation and recovery from deviations, while closed-loop evaluation is costly, difficult to scale, and often relies on simulated environments that may suffer from domain gaps. To bridge this gap, we propose VIPS, a benchmark for cooperative autonomous driving in V2I settings based on pseudo-simulation. VIPS extends pseudo-simulation by integrating vehicle and infrastructure observations. This enables scalable yet realistic evaluation of robustness and error propagation without full simulation. We further present CoS-V2X, a cooperative planning framework based on sparse representations. CoS-V2X models vehicle-infrastructure interactions using compact features for efficient communication and robust decision-making under heterogeneous observations. Code and dataset are available at https://vips2026.github.io.
summary_zh: 城市环境下的端到端自动驾驶需要在部分可观测与复杂多智能体交互条件下做出鲁棒决策。严重遮挡与路口密集交通限制了单智能体系统的感知能力，推动了近年来基于车-基础设施（V2I）协同的感知与规划研究。然而，现有评估协议面临根本性权衡：开环评估无法捕捉误差累积与偏差恢复能力，而闭环评估不仅成本高昂、难以扩展，且往往依赖于可能存在领域差异的仿真环境。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出VIPS——一个基于伪仿真的V2I协同自动驾驶基准。VIPS通过融合车辆与基础设施观测数据扩展了伪仿真方法，从而在无需完整仿真的条件下实现可扩展且符合实际的鲁棒性与误差传播评估。我们进一步提出CoS-V2X——一个基于稀疏表示的协同规划框架。CoS-V2X利用紧凑特征建模车辆-基础设施交互，以支持异构观测下的高效通信与鲁棒决策。代码与数据集见https://vips2026.github.io。
tldr: VIPS introduces a pseudo-simulation benchmark for cooperative autonomous driving in vehicle-infrastructure settings, enabling scalable closed-loop evaluation without full simulation, accompanied by a cooperative planning framework CoS-V2X using sparse representations.
tldr_zh: VIPS 提出了基于伪仿真的车路协同自动驾驶基准，实现可扩展的闭环评估，同时附带基于稀疏表示的协同规划框架 CoS-V2X。

title: Towards Zero-Shot Transfer Across Embodiments For Driving VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential in autonomous driving by leveraging multimodal pretraining for instruction following, visual reasoning, and scene-level generalization. In robotic manipulation, scaling VLA fine-tuning across multiple robot setups--especially when unifying representations across embodiments--has been shown to improve in-dataset performance and cross-embodiment generalization; in autonomous driving, however, VLAs remain largely trained on individual datasets and are rarely evaluated for zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets and camera rigs; furthermore naively adding more datasets to the training data does not necessarily lead to better performance within seen embodiments. To address these problems, we study multi-dataset training for the driving task and BEV-Forcing, an auxiliary objective that transfers ground-plane object-layout information from a specialized Bird's-Eye-View model into the VLA backbone. By encouraging the model to represent object position through a shared BEV spatial interface, we show that an auxiliary task such as BEV-Forcing can improve both in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance when training on a small number of camera rigs. As the number of training embodiments increases, however, the benefits of the auxiliary task are reduced; we present this as evidence that new techniques in the literature may see their benefits diminish when simply scaling up training diversity, which motivates presenting results taking into account data scaling.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）通过利用多模态预训练实现指令跟随、视觉推理及场景级泛化，在自动驾驶领域展现出巨大潜力。在机器人操作任务中，跨多机器人平台扩展VLA微调（尤其在统一不同本体表征时）已被证明能提升数据集内性能与跨本体泛化能力；然而在自动驾驶领域，VLAs仍主要基于单个数据集训练，且鲜少评估其对未见数据集及相机配置的零样本迁移效果。此外，简单地在训练数据中添加更多数据集并不一定能提升已见本体框架内的性能。为解决这些问题，我们针对驾驶任务研究了多数据集训练方法，并提出BEV-Forcing这一辅助目标——通过从专用鸟瞰图模型中将地面平面物体布局信息迁移至VLA主干网络。通过鼓励模型通过共享的BEV空间接口表征物体位置，我们证明：在少量相机配置下训练时，BEV-Forcing这类辅助任务能同时提升分布内与分布外性能。然而，随着训练本体数量的增加，辅助任务的收益逐渐减弱。我们将此作为证据，表明现有文献中的新技术在单纯扩大训练多样性时可能效果递减，这突显了在考虑数据规模扩展背景下呈现研究结果的重要性。
tldr: This paper proposes BEV-Forcing, an auxiliary objective that transfers bird's-eye-view layout information into driving VLAs to improve zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer, and shows that its benefits diminish with more training camera rigs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出BEV-Forcing辅助目标，将鸟瞰图布局信息注入驾驶VLA模型以提升跨本体零样本迁移能力，并发现其收益随训练相机支架数量增加而减弱。

title: World-Coherent Decoding: Self-Verifying Test-Time Planning for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to control robots by stochastically generating visual futures and then decoding actions, but empirical observations indicate that the results can strongly depend on which future is selected. We propose World-Coherent-Decoding (WCD), a self-verifying test-time planning framework that treats WAM rollouts as falsifiable future--action hypotheses. At each decision step, WCD samples multiple candidates from a frozen WAM and ranks them using internal generative signals: flow-based video surprisal for visual plausibility and action path effort for action-generation stability. After execution, the realized observation audits the selected imagination, yielding an imagination--reality mismatch that trains a lightweight online predictor for future candidate selection. Thus, WCD converts delayed self-verification into pre-execution reliability estimation without updating the backbone model. On RoboTwin 2.0, WCD improves Hard success under limited randomized-scene supervision from $55.80\%$ to $60.90\%$, with a $+16.43$ gains on Horizon-3 tasks, and shows qualitative robustness on real Franka visual-shift tests. These results highlight a simple principle: test-time scaling for WAMs depends less on sampling more futures than on selecting reliable ones.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）旨在通过随机生成视觉未来状态并解码对应动作来控制机器人，但经验观察表明，其结果在很大程度上取决于选择哪一个未来状态。我们提出世界一致性解码（WCD），这是一种自验证的测试时规划框架，将WAM的推演结果视为可证伪的未来-动作假设。在每个决策步骤中，WCD从冻结的WAM中采样多个候选方案，并利用内部生成信号对其进行排序：基于光流的视频惊异度用于衡量视觉合理性，动作路径代价用于衡量动作生成稳定性。执行后，实际观测结果对所选想象进行审核，产生想象-现实不匹配信号，进而训练一个轻量级在线预测器用于未来候选方案的选择。这样，WCD将延迟的自验证转化为执行前的可靠性估计，且无需更新主干模型。在RoboTwin 2.0上，WCD在有限随机场景监督下将Hard任务成功率从55.80%提升至60.90%，在Horizon-3任务上获得+16.43个百分点的增益，并在真实Franka视觉偏移测试中展现出定性鲁棒性。这些结果凸显了一个简单原则：WAM的测试时扩展更依赖于选择可靠的未来状态，而非采样更多未来状态。
tldr: World-Coherent Decoding (WCD) introduces a test-time planning framework that improves World Action Model (WAM) robot policies by self-verifying and selecting reliable future-action hypotheses, achieving higher task success without model retraining.
tldr_zh: 世界一致解码（WCD）提出了一种测试时规划框架，通过自我验证并选择可靠的未来-动作假设来改进世界行动模型（WAM）机器人策略，在不重新训练模型的情况下提高了任务成功率。

title: Toward Robust LiDAR Semantic Segmentation for Real-World Deployment: Evaluation under Coarse Labels, Adverse Conditions, and Domain Shifts
summary: LiDAR-based semantic segmentation is a core perception module for autonomous vehicles and mobile robots. Despite the strong performance of recent state-of-the-art methods on standard benchmarks, existing evaluation protocols remain focused on clean, single-domain settings and fine-grained label taxonomies, leaving deployment readiness largely unassessed. Real-world systems must handle safety-critical label semantics, degraded sensing conditions, and cross-domain variability, yet no unified protocol currently addresses all three aspects together. In this paper, we propose a structured evaluation protocol that assesses the deployment readiness of LiDAR semantic segmentation models along three complementary dimensions: (i) coarse-label evaluation aligned with autonomous driving safety priorities, revealing how label granularity affects different methods; (ii) robustness under eight types of LiDAR corruptions designed to emulate real-world atmospheric, geometric, and sensor degradations; and (iii) domain generalization across datasets without adaptation. The evaluation includes inference speed measured on an embedded Jetson AGX Orin platform, directly reflecting deployment constraints. Our results show that fine-grained benchmark rankings do not always reflect safety-relevant performance, that all methods experience substantial degradation under corruptions with architecture-dependent robustness characteristics, and that current domain generalization remains insufficient for reliable deployment. These findings expose concrete gaps between benchmark performance and deployment readiness, and provide a reference protocol for more practically grounded evaluation of LiDAR semantic segmentation.
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的语义分割是自动驾驶车辆与移动机器人的核心感知模块。尽管当前最先进方法在标准基准测试中表现强劲，但现有评估协议仍集中于干净的单域设置与细粒度标签分类体系，未能充分评估实际部署就绪性。现实系统必须处理安全关键的标签语义、退化的感知条件及跨域变异性，但目前尚无统一协议能同时涵盖这三方面。本文提出了一套结构化评估协议，从三个互补维度评估激光雷达语义分割模型的部署就绪性：（i）与自动驾驶安全优先级对齐的粗粒度标签评估，揭示标签粒度对不同方法的影响；（ii）针对八类模拟真实大气、几何及传感器退化的激光雷达干扰的鲁棒性测试；（iii）无需域适应的跨数据集泛化能力。评估包含在嵌入式Jetson AGX Orin平台上测量的推理速度，直接反映部署约束。结果表明：细粒度基准排名未必反映安全相关性能；所有方法在干扰下均出现显著性能下降，且鲁棒性特征与架构相关；当前域泛化能力仍不足以支持可靠部署。这些发现揭示了基准性能与部署就绪性之间的具体差距，并为更面向实际应用的激光雷达语义分割评估提供了参考协议。
tldr: Proposes a structured evaluation protocol for LiDAR semantic segmentation that assesses deployment readiness via coarse-label safety alignment, robustness to eight sensor corruptions, and domain generalization, revealing gaps between benchmark performance and real-world requirements for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种面向LiDAR语义分割的结构化评估协议，通过粗标签安全对齐、八种传感器退化鲁棒性和域泛化来评估部署就绪性，揭示了自动驾驶中基准性能与实际需求之间的差距。

title: Latent Cluster Analysis for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are increasingly used in robotics for their ability to ground language and perception into action, yet the internal representations driving their behaviour remain poorly understood. We propose LAVLA, a framework for latent cluster analysis of VLA models, and conduct a layer-wise study of the state-of-the-art GR00T N1.5 model, with particular focus on its action decoder. To better characterise the latent space during action diffusion, we introduce a cross-attention-based embedding-weighting method that amplifies relevant features while suppressing less informative ones. Quantitative evaluation shows that weighted clustering consistently outperforms the baseline. To improve interpretability, we extract human-interpretable concepts for each cluster, linking latent representations to semantic descriptions. Our analysis shows that latent clusters progressively disentangle spatiotemporal and kinematic features, with representations becoming more refined in the middle layers and stabilising toward the output. As such, LAVLA advances the interpretability of language-driven robotic systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因其将语言与感知转化为行动的能力，在机器人领域得到了日益广泛的应用，然而驱动其行为的内部表征仍缺乏深入理解。我们提出了LAVLA框架，用于对VLA模型进行潜在聚类分析，并对当前最先进的GR00T N1.5模型开展了逐层研究，重点关注其动作解码器。为了更好地刻画动作扩散过程中的潜在空间，我们引入了一种基于交叉注意力机制的嵌入加权方法，该方法能够增强相关特征并抑制信息量较少的特征。定量评估表明，加权聚类始终优于基线方法。为提升可解释性，我们为每个聚类提取了人类可理解的概念，将潜在表征与语义描述联系起来。分析显示，潜在聚类逐步解耦了时空与运动学特征，其中间层的表征更为精细，并在输出层趋于稳定。由此，LAVLA推进了语言驱动机器人系统的可解释性研究。
tldr: LAVLA introduces a cross-attention-based embedding-weighting method for latent cluster analysis of VLA models, improving interpretability of the GR00T N1.5 action decoder by linking latent representations to semantic concepts.
tldr_zh: LAVLA 提出了一种基于交叉注意力的嵌入加权方法，用于VLA模型的潜在聚类分析，通过将潜在表示与语义概念关联，提高了GR00T N1.5动作解码器的可解释性。

title: MS-MEM: Multi-Skill Manipulation-Enhanced Mapping via Uncertainty- and Disturbance-Aware Action Selection
summary: Accurate scene understanding in confined, cluttered spaces such as shelves is essential for service robots, as many everyday tasks require them to locate and retrieve objects reliably. Yet, it remains challenging due to severe occlusions, restricted accessibility, and the need to avoid excessive scene changes. In this paper, we propose Multi-Skill Manipulation-Enhanced Mapping (MS-MEM), an evidential framework for uncertainty-aware mapping that integrates active viewpoint selection, object pushing, and grasping. MS-MEM combines scene-level metric-semantic evidential belief estimators with an uncertainty-aware grasp representation. This representation is learned using a novel full-evidential grasp estimator that models both grasp affordance and orientation uncertainty. In our framework, candidate perception and manipulation actions are evaluated within a unified action selection pipeline using a common information gain criterion. For manipulation actions, we further introduce a collateral disturbance constraint (CDC) that discourages excessive changes to confident regions of the scene belief. This enables MS-MEM to select actions that effectively reduce map uncertainty while limiting collateral scene changes. Experimental results show that, compared with single-skill and unconstrained baselines that ignore scene disturbance, MS-MEM achieves higher mapping accuracy while substantially reducing scene disturbance, highlighting the synergistic effects of active viewpoint selection, push, and grasp actions.
summary_zh: 在受限、杂乱的场景（如货架）中实现精确的场景理解对于服务机器人至关重要，因为许多日常任务要求它们可靠地定位和取回物体。然而，由于严重的遮挡、受限的可达性以及需要避免对场景造成过度改变，这仍然是一项挑战。在本文中，我们提出多技能操作增强建图（MS-MEM）——一种用于不确定性感知建图的证据框架，集成了主动视角选择、物体推搡与抓取操作。MS-MEM将场景级度量-语义证据置信估计器与一种不确定性感知的抓取表示相结合。该表示通过一种新型的全证据抓取估计器学习，该估计器同时对抓取可行性和方向不确定性进行建模。在我们的框架中，候选的感知与操作动作通过统一的信息增益准则在统一的动作选择流程中进行评估。对于操作动作，我们进一步引入附带扰动约束（CDC），该约束抑制对场景置信中高确定性区域的过度改变。这使得MS-MEM能够选择有效降低地图不确定性同时限制附带场景改变的动作。实验结果表明，与忽略场景扰动的单技能和无约束基线方法相比，MS-MEM在实现更高建图精度的同时显著减少了场景扰动，凸显了主动视角选择、推搡与抓取动作的协同效应。
tldr: MS-MEM integrates active viewpoint selection, object pushing, and grasping into an evidential mapping framework to improve scene understanding in cluttered spaces while minimizing unintended disturbances.
tldr_zh: MS-MEM 将主动视角选择、物体推动和抓取整合到一个证据建图框架中，以提高杂乱环境中的场景理解，同时最小化非预期的干扰。

title: A Physics-Consistent Benchmark for Contact-Rich Human-Robot Interaction in Assistive Care
summary: Conventional task-level evaluation asks whether a robot policy completes a specified action, but can miss failures that emerge only during physical human contact. This limitation is critical in contact-rich assistive tasks, where meaningful evaluation requires a physically responsive human, interaction-quality assessment beyond task success, and a leak-free observer-scorer protocol. We introduce a physics-consistent benchmark for contact-rich human-robot interaction, instantiated in robot-assisted bathing. The benchmark combines a deformable, passively responding human, physics-aware scores alongside task-level success, and a frozen vision-only / scorer-only evaluation protocol. To establish physical validity, region-wise simulated responses are calibrated against force-indentation measurements from Franka impedance pushes on a medical-care manikin. Under a frozen T1-T7 protocol with 140 runs per method, an LLM-augmented state machine (State Machine) achieves 72.9% task success but drops to 56.4% after correct-region and force-safety screening; VoxPoser produces lighter and more stable contact but completes only 27.9% of trials; and zero-shot pi0.5 achieves 0.7% task success with no correct-region or safety-gated successes. These results show that task completion alone does not imply physically valid contact and motivate physics-aware screening before deployment of contact-rich assistive robot policies.
summary_zh: 传统的任务级评估仅关注机器人策略是否完成指定动作，却可能遗漏仅在实际物理接触中出现的失败。这一局限在接触密集的辅助任务中尤为关键——此类任务需要具备物理响应的真人、超越任务成功率的交互质量评估，以及无泄漏的观察者-评分者协议。我们提出了一种面向接触密集人机交互的物理一致性基准，以机器人辅助沐浴为实例化场景。该基准结合了可变形、被动响应的人体模型，融合物理感知评分与任务级成功率，并采用冻结的纯视觉/仅评分者评估协议。为验证物理有效性，区域响应曲线通过Franka阻抗推压医用护理假人的力-压痕测量数据进行校准。在每次方法运行140次的冻结T1-T7协议下，LLM增强状态机实现72.9%的任务成功率，但经正确区域与力安全筛选后骤降至56.4%；VoxPoser生成更轻缓稳定的接触，但仅完成27.9%的试验；零样本pi0.5的任务成功率为0.7%，且未产生任何正确区域或安全门控成功案例。这些结果表明，任务完成本身并不等同于物理有效的接触，在部署接触密集的辅助机器人策略前，必须进行物理感知筛查。
tldr: A physics-consistent benchmark for contact-rich human-robot interaction, tested on robot-assisted bathing with a deformable human model, physics-aware scores, and a frozen protocol, showing that task success alone misses unsafe contact.
tldr_zh: 一个物理一致的接触丰富人机交互基准，在机器人辅助沐浴中测试了可变形人体模型、物理感知分数和冻结协议，表明仅任务成功会遗漏不安全接触。

title: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
summary: Humanoid robots responding to emergency stop commands typically execute a fixed maneuver, without reasoning about whether a safe stop is actually feasible from the current state. We cast emergency stopping as a reach-avoid problem and propose Safe-Stop, a task-agnostic framework that pairs a learned stop policy with learned stoppability estimators. The estimators are complementary: a stop-probability estimator supervised by the actual outcomes of the fixed stop policy, and a reach-avoidance estimator supervised by a Hamilton-Jacobi backup over physical state. The first captures emergent stopping behavior of the learned controller; the second provides a complementary recoverability signal. Because the stop policy and estimators do not depend on the behavior policy that preceded the stop command, they transfer across diverse upstream tasks without retraining. At deployment, the two estimates are combined: Safe-Stop commits to the stop only when both estimators indicate that stopping remains feasible, otherwise it hands off to a fall policy, instantiated as a damping fallback. This agreement check yields decisions that are robust without sacrificing reactivity.
summary_zh: 类人机器人在响应紧急停止指令时，通常执行固定动作，而不推理当前状态下安全停止是否实际可行。我们将紧急停止问题建模为"到达-规避"问题，并提出Safe-Stop这一任务无关框架，其通过将学习型停止策略与学习型可停止性估计器相结合。估计器具有互补性：停止概率估计器通过固定停止策略的实际结果进行监督，而到达-规避估计器则通过基于物理状态的Hamilton-Jacobi备份进行监督。前者捕捉了学习控制器的紧急停止行为，后者提供了互补的可恢复性信号。由于停止策略与估计器不依赖于停止指令前的行为策略，因此可在无需重新训练的情况下跨不同上游任务迁移。部署时，两种估计被结合使用：仅当两个估计器均指示停止仍可行时，Safe-Stop才执行停止操作，否则将控制权移交给作为阻尼回退机制实现的备用策略。这种一致性检查机制可产生兼具鲁棒性与响应灵敏度的决策。
tldr: Safe-Stop introduces a task-agnostic framework for humanoid robots to decide whether an emergency stop is feasible, combining a learned stop policy with two complementary stoppability estimators and a fallback fall policy.
tldr_zh: Safe-Stop 提出了一种任务无关的框架，使人形机器人能够判断紧急停止是否可行，结合了学习到的停止策略与两个互补的停止可行性估计器以及一个跌倒回退策略。

title: LookStep: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation with Linguistic Foresight and Event Driven Memory
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions in unseen environments. Recent progress has been largely driven by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing methods follow a next-step action prediction paradigm, supervising only the expert action, which requires a high quantity of data for training. They also rely on cognitive maps, accumulated historical frames, or external 3D tools to maintain states, leading to high computational and memory overhead. To realize resource efficiency VLN, we propose LookStep, a unified end-to-end framework that combines Language Centric Future State Modeling and Event Driven Rolling Memory that uses language labels to generate coarse-grained navigation progress and future states for each candidate action, while autonomously deciding whether to write each observation into a bounded rolling memory with a semantic role. We validate LookStep empirically. On VLN-CE tasks, LookStep outperforms existing methods under the same training settings, achieving a 49.7\% success rate on R2R-CE Val-Unseen with better memory efficiency and less data usage. Code and model is available at https://github.com/kunyang-YU/LookStep.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在未知环境中遵循自然语言指令。近期进展主要由多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）推动。现有方法采用单步动作预测范式，仅对专家动作施加监督，这需要大量数据进行训练。它们还依赖认知地图、累积的历史帧或外部3D工具来维护状态，导致高昂的计算与内存开销。为实现资源高效的VLN，我们提出LookStep——一个统一的端到端框架，结合了以语言为中心的未来状态建模与事件驱动的滚动记忆：通过语言标签为每个候选动作生成粗粒度的导航进展和未来状态，同时自主决定是否将每个观测以语义角色写入有界的滚动记忆。我们通过实验验证了LookStep。在VLN-CE任务中，LookStep在相同训练设置下超越现有方法，在R2R-CE Val-Unseen上实现49.7%的成功率，同时具备更优的内存效率与更少的数据用量。代码与模型已开源：https://github.com/kunyang-YU/LookStep。
tldr: LookStep proposes a unified end-to-end VLN framework with Language Centric Future State Modeling and Event Driven Rolling Memory for efficient navigation.
tldr_zh: LookStep 提出了一个统一的端到端 VLN 框架，通过语言中心的未来状态建模和事件驱动的滚动内存实现高效导航。

title: Contact-Constrained Lower-Limb Joint-Offset Calibration for Humanoid Robots
summary: Accurate joint encoder offsets are essential for kinematic consistency in humanoid lower limbs, yet existing calibration methods typically require external motion-capture systems or fiducial targets. We present a self-contained calibration framework exploiting only onboard joint encoders and a pelvis-mounted IMU during static double-support contact. The inter-foot transform from forward kinematics must stay constant when both feet are fixed; minimizing its posture-dependent dispersion yields a nonlinear least-squares problem over the 12-dimensional offset vector. A Hessian eigenstructure analysis shows that parallel pitch axes induce a rotational coupling. Orientation residuals then observe only the pitch-offset sum, while translation and posture diversity set the remaining numerical observability. For the A3 pitch-to-roll-to-yaw ordering, hip-roll and hip-yaw excitation reduce hip-pitch coupling. A standing-posture knee prior then anchors the remaining weak pitch-chain decomposition. Simulation and real-machine injection tests show consistent recovery, and on held-out recordings calibration reduces foot-height RMS residuals from 4.26 to 2.20 mm on A3 and from 8.03 to 1.43 mm on A2. An independent LiDAR-inertial reference checks the pitch-coupled channel. Removing an injected pitch offset moves the leg-odometry vertical drift back toward the LiDAR trajectory. A few static double-support stances thus provide contact-consistent corrections for well-excited directions. Individual offsets in the weak pitch chain remain prior-dependent.
summary_zh: 精确的关节编码器零位偏移对于仿人下肢的运动学一致性至关重要，然而现有的标定方法通常需要外部运动捕捉系统或基准靶标。我们提出了一种自包含标定框架，仅利用内置关节编码器和骨盆安装的惯性测量单元（IMU），在静态双足支撑接触状态下完成标定。当双足固定时，由正向运动学导出的足间变换必须保持恒定；最小化其随姿态变化的分散度可得到一个关于12维偏移向量的非线性最小二乘问题。Hessian矩阵的特征结构分析表明，平行俯仰轴会引发旋转耦合，此时方向残差仅能观测到俯仰偏移之和，而平移与姿态多样性则决定了其余数值可观测性。针对A3型机器人采用的俯仰-横滚-偏航顺序，髋关节横滚和偏航激励可降低髋关节俯仰耦合。随后，通过站立姿态的膝关节先验值锚定剩余弱俯仰链的分解。仿真与实际样机注入测试显示偏移量可稳定恢复，在预留测试数据中，标定将A3机器人的足高RMS残差从4.26 mm降至2.20 mm，将A2机器人从8.03 mm降至1.43 mm。独立的激光雷达-惯性参考系统对俯仰耦合通道进行校验：移除注入的俯仰偏移后，腿部里程计的垂直漂移向激光雷达轨迹收敛。因此，少量静态双足支撑姿态可为充分激励的方向提供接触一致性校正，而弱俯仰链中的个体偏移仍依赖于先验值。
tldr: A self-contained calibration framework for humanoid lower-limb joint offsets using only onboard encoders and a pelvis IMU during static double-support, reducing foot-height residuals to 1.43 mm.
tldr_zh: 一种仅利用本体编码器和骨盆IMU在静态双足支撑期间进行人形机器人下肢关节偏移自校准的方法，将足高残差降至1.43毫米。

title: Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoids with Learned Point Cloud Correspondence
summary: Humanoid learning increasingly relies on transforming vast and diverse human motion data into high-quality robot reference trajectories. However, retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is challenging due to substantial differences in morphology, degrees of freedom, joint ranges, and kinematic constraints between humans and robots. Existing retargeting methods typically address these differences by defining human-robot correspondence through hand-crafted sparse keypoints or body-part pairs. As a result, retargeting quality depends heavily on manual semantic design, limiting scalability across motion sources and robot morphologies and providing only sparse guidance for reproducing detailed poses and interactions. In this paper, we present Unified Motion Retargeting (UMR), a framework that learns dense point cloud correspondence without requiring manually designed human-robot mappings. By treating exterior point clouds as a unified interface between human motion and humanoid robots, UMR decouples retargeting from source-specific skeletal semantics and robot-specific topology. The learned dense correspondence provides fine-grained geometric anchors for constrained point cloud matching optimization, enabling surface-level pose alignment and direct transfer of interaction contacts. Experiments demonstrate that UMR unifies retargeting across heterogeneous motion sources, robot embodiments, and downstream scenarios ranging from locomotion to interaction, while achieving higher motion fidelity and plausibility than state-of-the-art methods. UMR therefore provides a scalable foundation for transforming large-scale human motion references into robot-ready training data.
summary_zh: 人形机器人学习日益依赖将海量且多样的人类运动数据转化为高质量的机器人参考轨迹。然而，由于人与机器人在形态、自由度、关节运动范围及运动学约束上存在显著差异，将人类运动重定向至人形机器人仍具有挑战性。现有重定向方法通常通过手工设计的稀疏关键点或身体部位配对来定义人机关联，以此应对这些差异。这导致重定向质量严重依赖人工语义设计，限制了其在多源运动数据与多种机器人形态上的可扩展性，且仅能为复现精细姿态与交互提供稀疏的引导。本文提出统一运动重定向框架（UMR），该框架无需人工设计人机映射关系即可学习稠密点云对应。通过将外部点云作为人类运动与人形机器人之间的统一接口，UMR将重定向过程与特定源数据的骨骼语义及特定机器人的拓扑结构解耦。所学习的稠密对应关系可为受约束的点云匹配优化提供细粒度几何锚点，从而支持表面级姿态对齐与交互接触的直接迁移。实验表明，UMR能统一异构运动源、不同机器人形态以及从移动操作到交互行为等多种下游场景中的重定向任务，在运动保真度与合理性上均超越现有最优方法。因此，UMR为将大规模人类运动参考转化为机器人就绪训练数据提供了可扩展的基础架构。
tldr: UMR learns dense point cloud correspondence for humanoid motion retargeting, eliminating hand-crafted keypoint mappings and enabling fine-grained pose and contact transfer across diverse motion sources and robot embodiments.
tldr_zh: UMR 通过学习稠密点云对应，消除了人工设计的稀疏关键点映射，实现了跨异构运动源和机器人形态的精细姿态与接触迁移。

title: Real-Time Dynamics-Based Torque-Sampling MPPI for Compliant and Force Aware Manipulation
summary: This study proposes a novel Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI)-based task-space control framework. The proposed framework explicitly solves rigid-body dynamics within a real-time MPC formulation and enforces safety constraints, enabling accurate motion and force control that yields compliant behaviors for safe and effective physical interaction of robotic manipulators in unstructured environments. By leveraging MPPI, the proposed framework efficiently handles nonlinear dynamics that are difficult to solve with conventional MPC approaches in real-time. Furthermore, we develop a torque-sampling-based control architecture that enables efficient exploitation of GPU-based parallelization, resulting in effective compliant and force-aware behaviors. As a result, the proposed framework achieves a solver update rate of over 166 Hz with a 0.18 s prediction horizon, and its performance is validated through real-world experiments on a 7-DoF manipulator.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）的任务空间控制框架。该框架在实时MPC公式中显式求解刚体动力学并施加安全约束，从而实现精确的运动与力控制，使机器人在非结构化环境中具备柔顺行为，以进行安全且有效的物理交互。通过利用MPPI，该框架能够高效处理传统MPC方法难以实时求解的非线性动力学问题。此外，我们开发了一种基于力矩采样的控制架构，可充分利用基于GPU的并行化计算，从而实现有效的柔顺与力感知行为。最终，该框架在0.18秒预测时域内实现了超过166 Hz的求解器更新频率，并通过在七自由度机械臂上的实际实验验证了其性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time MPPI-based task-space control framework that solves rigid-body dynamics for robotic manipulators, using torque-sampling and GPU parallelization to achieve compliant and force-aware behaviors at over 166 Hz.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于MPPI的实时任务空间控制框架，通过解算刚体动力学并使用扭矩采样与GPU并行化，在7自由度机械臂上实现了超过166 Hz的柔顺与力感知控制。

title: MACAW: Reliable And Efficient Surgical Debridement Using Monocular Adaptive Compact Attention Windows
summary: Augmenting the dexterity of human surgeons has the potential to free them from tedious subtasks. We consider debridement (removal of diseased or dead tissue fragments), which is challenging due to imprecision in spatial perception and cable actuation. We develop an augmented dexterity system for surgical debridement that uses visual servoing to align the cable-driven gripper with the target position in the image plane, and then introduces a novel approach to depth control, MACAW: Monocular Adaptive Compact Attention Windows. Across 100 physical trials using the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) robot, camera-frame servoing reduced average gripper position offset from 37 to fewer than 5 pixels within 4 optimization steps, taking an average of only 0.39s. MACAW significantly outperforms procedural and learned VLA baselines, achieving a 93% success rate at 11 seconds per fragment, yielding a throughput of 304 fragments per hour. Extending MACAW to a bimanual debridement setup maintains a 92% success rate at an average of 7 seconds per fragment, increasing the throughput to 473 fragments per hour.
summary_zh: 增强外科医生灵巧操作能力的潜力在于使其从繁琐的子任务中解放出来。我们聚焦于清创术（切除病变或坏死组织碎片），这一任务因空间感知不精确和缆绳驱动问题而颇具挑战。为此，我们开发了一套用于外科清创的灵巧增强系统：通过视觉伺服将缆绳驱动夹爪对准图像平面中的目标位置，并提出了一种新颖的深度控制方法——MACAW（单目自适应紧凑注意力窗口）。在使用达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）机器人进行的100次物理实验中，基于相机坐标系的伺服控制可在4次优化步骤内将平均夹爪位置偏移从37像素降至不足5像素，平均耗时仅0.39秒。MACAW显著优于程序化基线方法和基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的基线方法，实现了每个碎片11秒、93%的成功率，对应每小时304个碎片的处理通量。将MACAW扩展至双臂清创配置后，成功率维持在92%，平均每个碎片处理时间缩短至7秒，通量提升至每小时473个碎片。
tldr: This paper presents MACAW, a visual servoing and adaptive depth control system for surgical debridement using the da Vinci Research Kit, achieving high-speed and reliable fragment removal.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MACAW，一种结合视觉伺服与自适应深度控制的手术清创系统，在达芬奇研究套件上实现了高速可靠的碎片清除。

title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: We introduce SolarWM, a fully open foundation for building interactive video world models from data preparation through long-horizon inference. Training across heterogeneous data sources and video backbones is challenging: datasets differ in temporal scale, camera geometry, visual quality, motion, and captioning styles, while video generators use distinct representations and architectures. Naive data mixing and model-specific implementations therefore produce inconsistent supervision and make results difficult to reproduce and compare. SolarWM addresses this coupling with a reconfigurable multi-source data engine and a backbone-native adaptation framework. The engine converts 1.43 million canonical clips from 10 datasets into a unified, frame-aligned contract covering visual observations, metric camera geometry, captions, quality metadata, selection decisions, and provenance, while decoupling source processing from mixture construction. Under shared camera-conditioning, training, and inference interfaces, we instantiate four 5B--33B models based on Wan2.2, LTX-2.5, and MiniMax-H3 while preserving their native representations and objectives. A unified three-stage recipe combines bidirectional adaptation, teacher-forced autoregressive initialization, and distribution matching distillation. The resulting causal models enable real-time interaction over rollouts ranging from minutes to hours after being trained on only 5s sequences. By releasing the resulting data, pipeline, recipes, weights, and framework, SolarWM provides a reproducible and extensible foundation for interactive world-model research.
summary_zh: 我们推出SolarWM——一个完全开放的基础框架，旨在构建交互式视频世界模型，覆盖从数据准备到长期推理的全流程。跨异构数据源和视频主干网络进行训练极具挑战性：数据集在时间尺度、相机几何、视觉质量、运动模式及字幕风格上存在差异，而视频生成器则采用不同的表征与架构。因此，简单混合数据及针对特定模型的实现会造成监督信号不一致，使结果难以复现与比较。SolarWM通过可重构的多源数据引擎与主干原生适配框架解决了上述耦合问题。该引擎将来自10个数据集的143万个规范视频片段转换为统一的、基于帧对齐的合约，涵盖视觉观测、度量相机几何、字幕、质量元数据、选择决策及来源信息，同时将源数据处理与混合构建解耦。在共享的相机条件设定、训练与推理接口下，我们基于Wan2.2、LTX-2.5和MiniMax-H3分别实例化了四个规模在5B至33B之间的模型，同时保留了各模型的原生表征与目标函数。一套统一的三阶段方案整合了双向适配、教师强迫自回归初始化以及分布匹配蒸馏。最终得到的因果模型仅需在5秒序列上训练后，即可在数分钟至数小时的推演中实现实时交互。通过开放所生成的数据、流程、方案、权重及框架，SolarWM为交互式世界模型研究提供了可复现且可扩展的基础。
tldr: SolarWM provides an open-source, scalable framework for building interactive video world models by unifying heterogeneous data and backbones, enabling real-time long-horizon rollout from short training sequences.
tldr_zh: SolarWM 提供了一个开源的、可扩展的框架，通过统一异构数据和骨干网络来构建交互式视频世界模型，能够从短序列训练实现实时长时程推演。

title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding is a critical capability for real-world applications, including embodied intelligence, autonomous driving, industrial monitoring, surveillance and early warning, and wearable assistants. However, processing continuous video streams with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is computationally expensive. Existing efforts have explored reducing streaming overhead through visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offloading. However, most existing methods overlook the dimension of model depth. Repeatedly executing full-depth MLLM prefill over incoming frames is prohibitively expensive, incurring substantial computational overhead and causing the KV cache to grow at a rate directly proportional to the prefill depth. To address these challenges, we propose ShallowStream, a novel framework that leverages the shallow layers of an MLLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval index building. During stream processing, ShallowStream maintains an always-on lightweight index using the KV cache of shallow layers. During query-time answering, we leverage the attention scores generated by the shallow layers to score context frames and employ a diversity-aware selection strategy to retrieve precise and comprehensive evidence. ShallowStream achieves performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods, while reducing per-frame prefill latency and 10-second end-to-end latency by up to 52.1x and 11.9x, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream.
summary_zh: 流式视频理解对于具身智能、自动驾驶、工业监控、安防预警以及可穿戴助手等现实应用而言，是一项关键能力。然而，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）处理连续视频流的计算成本十分高昂。现有工作已探索通过视觉标记剪枝、标记合并、量化、按需帧检索及上下文卸载等方式降低流式处理开销，但大多数现有方法忽视了模型深度这一维度。对输入帧重复执行全深度MLLM预填充会带来难以承受的代价，不仅造成巨大的计算开销，还会导致KV缓存增长速度与预填充深度成正比。为解决这些挑战，我们提出ShallowStream——一种新颖框架，它利用MLLM的浅层同时进行帧编码和检索索引构建。在流式处理过程中，ShallowStream通过浅层KV缓存维护一个始终在线的轻量级索引。在查询时回答阶段，我们利用浅层生成的注意力分数对上下文帧进行评分，并采用多样性感知的选择策略来检索精确且全面的证据。ShallowStream实现了与现有最强流式方法相当的性能，同时将每帧预填充延迟和10秒端到端延迟分别降低高达52.1倍和11.9倍。我们的代码开源在https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream。
tldr: ShallowStream proposes a framework that uses only shallow layers of an MLLM for streaming video frame encoding and indexing, drastically reducing latency while maintaining state-of-the-art streaming video QA performance, with explicit applications to embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: ShallowStream 提出一种仅利用 MLLM 浅层进行流式视频帧编码和索引的框架，大幅降低延迟同时保持最先进的流式视频问答性能，明确面向具身智能和自动驾驶应用。

title: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
summary: Predictive models are increasingly used in robotics for state estimation, planning, control, and policy evaluation, yet they are often judged by open-loop prediction accuracy over a fixed horizon. In closed-loop operation, a robot repeatedly acts, receives new measurements, updates its state estimate, and recomputes control. We study this difference in a differential-drive path-tracking task with biased odometry and intermittent landmark sensing. Six state estimators are evaluated across 24 sensing conditions using trajectory replay, a 20-step measurement-free rollout, and closed-loop tracking. Replay position RMSE correlates more strongly with closed-loop cross-track RMSE than rollout error (Spearman rho = 0.923 vs. 0.774) and selects a different estimator from the closed-loop optimum in 5/24 conditions, compared with 18/24 for the rollout metric. We then vary rollout horizon and measurement-update interval. With H=20, rank agreement decreases from rho = 0.916 with measurements at every step to rho = 0.774 with no measurements. A horizon-update grid shows that long prediction horizons remain informative when regular corrections are retained, whereas long rollouts without correction can produce rankings that differ substantially from closed-loop behavior. We also test recurrent estimators trained on longer sensing outages. This improves the EKF-anchored models under combined sensing degradation, reducing GRU-EKF cross-track RMSE from 1.72 m to 1.06 m, but the gain is not consistent across isolated outages or estimator architectures. These results show that predictive-model evaluation in robotics should specify both prediction horizon and measurement-update schedule. For models used in feedback, offline rollouts are most informative when their sensing and correction pattern reflects closed-loop operation. Code is available at https://github.com/rdharini2001/Robot_World_Model
summary_zh: 预测模型在机器人学中越来越多地被用于状态估计、规划、控制和策略评估，然而这些模型往往仅依据固定时域内的开环预测精度进行评判。在闭环运行中，机器人会重复执行动作、接收新测量值、更新状态估计并重新计算控制量。本研究针对一个具有有偏里程计和间歇性路标感知的差速驱动路径跟踪任务，探讨了这一差异。通过轨迹回放、20步无测量展开以及闭环跟踪，在24种感知条件下对六种状态估计器进行了评估。回放位置均方根误差与闭环横向跟踪均方根误差的相关性（斯皮尔曼相关系数rho = 0.923）强于展开误差（rho = 0.774），并且在24种条件中的5种情况下，回放指标选出的最优估计器与闭环最优估计器不同，而展开指标则在24种条件中的18种情况下与之不同。随后，我们改变了展开时域和测量更新间隔。当H=20时，等级一致性从每步均有测量时的rho = 0.916下降至无测量时的rho = 0.774。一个时域-更新网格表明，当保留定期校正时，长预测时域仍能提供有效信息；而无校正的长展开则可能产生与闭环行为显著不同的排序结果。我们还测试了针对更长感知中断进行训练的循环估计器。这改善了在组合感知退化条件下的EKF锚定模型，使GRU-EKF的横向跟踪均方根误差从1.72米降至1.06米，但在孤立中断或不同估计器架构下，这种增益并不一致。这些结果表明，机器人学中的预测模型评估应同时明确预测时域和测量更新调度。对于用于反馈的模型而言，当其感知和校正模式反映闭环操作时，离线展开最具信息价值。代码获取地址：https://github.com/rdharini2001/Robot_World_Model
tldr: This paper systematically studies how offline rollout metrics correlate with closed-loop robot control performance in a differential-drive path-tracking task, showing that replay position RMSE is a better indicator than open-loop rollout error.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究了离线展开指标与闭环机器人控制性能之间的相关性，在差速驱动路径跟踪任务中发现回放位置RMSE比开环展开误差更能指示闭环性能。

title: Pre-Lane-change Signal in Transitional Autonomous Vehicles: Results from Controlled Experiments
summary:
This paper investigates how a production transitional autonomous vehicle (tAV) develops and executes mandatory lane-change decisions. Using 150 controlled mandatory lane changes from the NC-tALC experiments, the study examines whether the eventual target gap is observable before lateral movement begins and how the tAV progresses longitudinally from that pre-lane-change state to lane-change start.
  Signal time (SigT) is defined as an operational pre-lane-change-start reference point. A Firth logistic regression predicts whether the tAV eventually merges in front of or behind its nearest target-lane vehicle using relative position and relative speed at SigT. Longitudinal progression from SigT to lane-change start is then examined separately for in-position and repositioning cases.
  The traffic state at SigT contains substantial information about eventual target-gap choice and provides meaningful lead time before lateral movement begins. The proposed formulation predicts whether the tAV remains with its current gap or repositions to a neighboring gap by moving forward or dropping back, including cases with longitudinal overlap and ambiguous current-gap geometry. The model achieves an average five-fold cross-validated accuracy of 0.89. Results also provide preliminary evidence that in-position and repositioning cases follow different longitudinal pathways from SigT to lane-change start.
  These findings support a two-stage conjecture of the observable lane-change process: longitudinal preparation from SigT to lane-change start, followed by lateral maneuver execution. The formulation applies to in-position, repositioning, and longitudinally overlapping cases, and can support lane-change models that distinguish target-gap choice from lateral-onset timing while representing longitudinal preparation before lateral movement begins.
summary_zh:
本文研究了量产过渡型自动驾驶车辆如何制定并执行强制变道决策。基于NC-tALC实验中150个受控强制变道案例，本研究探究了以下问题：横向移动开始前能否观测到最终目标间隙，以及自动驾驶车辆如何从变道前状态纵向演进至变道起始点。

信号时间被定义为变道起始前的操作参考点。通过费希尔逻辑回归模型，利用信号时间点的相对位置与相对速度，预测自动驾驶车辆最终将并入最近目标车道车辆的前方还是后方。随后针对就位与重新定位两种情况，分别分析了从信号时间到变道起始点的纵向演进过程。

信号时间点的交通状态包含了最终目标间隙选择的关键信息，并在横向移动开始前提供了有意义的提前时间。本文提出的方法可预测自动驾驶车辆是保持当前间隙，还是通过前移或后退重新定位至相邻间隙，包括存在纵向重叠及当前间隙几何关系模糊的情况。该模型平均五折交叉验证准确率达到0.89。研究结果还初步表明，就位与重新定位两种情况从信号时间到变道起始点遵循不同的纵向路径。

这些发现支持了可观测变道过程的两阶段假说：从信号时间到变道起始点的纵向准备阶段，随后是横向操作执行阶段。该建模方法适用于就位、重新定位及纵向重叠场景，可为区分目标间隙选择与横向起始时机的变道模型提供支持，同时表征横向移动开始前的纵向准备过程。
tldr: This paper studies the pre-lane-change signal in transitional autonomous vehicles by analyzing controlled lane-change experiments, proposing a logistic regression model to predict target-gap choice based on traffic state before lateral movement begins.
tldr_zh: 本文通过分析受控的换道实验，研究了过渡性自动驾驶车辆中的换道前信号，提出了一种基于换道前交通状态预测目标间隙选择的逻辑回归模型。

title: Hardware-Accelerated Instance Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Space Robotics with Criticality Analysis
summary: Autonomous lunar missions require real-time per- ception under three coupled constraints: extreme low-light conditions, limited onboard compute, and radiation-induced hardware faults that can silently corrupt inference. We present a deployment-oriented instance segmentation framework for resource-constrained lunar robotics that jointly addresses quan- tization calibration and system-level fault exposure under strict compute constraints. First, we introduce Activation Variance Informative Sampling (AVIS), a label-free calibration strategy that deterministically selects calibration samples based on activation variance statistics. Second, we deploy a YOLO-based segmentation model on a Deep Learning Processor Unit (DPU) with architectural modifications that reduce CPU fallback paths and enable statically compiled execution with bounded latency in low-lighting conditions. We further introduce a software-level criticality analysis to estimate fault exposure and guide mitigation under radiation-constrained operation. On a lunar micro-rover platform, AVIS with bias correction recovers 69.8% of quantization-induced accuracy loss while achieving 309 ms inference latency and 5.7 W power consumption. Targeted mitigation reduces global criticality by 31.7%. The results demonstrate an integrated approach and a blueprint for a reliable and safe AI perception framework under space deployment constraints.
summary_zh: 自主月球任务需在三种耦合约束下实现实时感知：极端弱光条件、有限星载计算能力，以及可能静默破坏推理的辐射诱发硬件故障。我们提出一种面向资源受限月球机器人的部署导向实例分割框架，该框架在严格计算约束下联合解决量化校准与系统级故障暴露问题。首先，我们引入激活方差信息采样（AVIS），这是一种无标签校准策略，基于激活方差统计确定性地选择校准样本。其次，我们在深度学习处理器单元（DPU）上部署基于YOLO的分割模型，通过架构改进减少CPU回退路径，实现在弱光条件下具有有界延迟的静态编译执行。我们进一步引入软件级关键性分析以评估故障暴露程度，并指导辐射约束运行下的缓解措施。在月球微巡视器平台上，采用偏差校正的AVIS恢复了69.8%的量化精度损失，同时实现了309毫秒推理延迟与5.7瓦功耗。靶向缓解措施将全局关键性降低31.7%。研究结果展示了一套集成方法，为空间部署约束下可靠安全的AI感知框架提供了蓝图。
tldr: This paper presents a hardware-accelerated instance segmentation framework for resource-constrained lunar robotics, addressing low-light conditions, limited compute, and radiation-induced faults via quantization calibration and criticality analysis, achieving significant accuracy recovery and latency reduction on a micro-rover platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向资源受限月球机器人的硬件加速实例分割框架，通过量化校准和关键性分析解决低光照、有限计算和辐射故障问题，在微型火星车上实现了显著的精度恢复和延迟降低。

title: TAPVid-MV: A Benchmark for Tracking Any Point in 3D Across Multiple Views
summary:
Multi-camera systems are increasingly practical for robotics, AR/VR, and autonomous driving because complementary views reduce depth ambiguity and preserve visibility under occlusion. Existing point-tracking benchmarks, however, focus on a single video or static multi-camera rigs. None test long-term 3D point tracking across several synchronized views under camera motion. We introduce TAPVid-MV (Tracking Any Point in Video across Multiple Views), the first benchmark for this setting. It contains a curated set of 284 sequences, 1,142 calibrated camera streams, and 109,769 point tracks across seven subsets spanning indoor and outdoor domains, from robotics and human activity to driving and synthetic procedural scenes. We obtain these trajectories using dataset-specific auxiliary modalities: sensor depth, LiDAR, SLAM and SfM points, human meshes, posed object meshes, and simulation. Every sequence and trajectory is visually verified by human annotators.
  Across more than 30 baselines, no method comes close to solving the task. Surprisingly, existing multi-view point trackers do not consistently outperform monocular point trackers. By evaluating reconstruction and point tracking on the same datasets, TAPVid-MV helps distinguish errors in recovered geometry from errors in point correspondence. Through this joint analysis, we identify geometry recovery as a major bottleneck for accurate 3D point tracking. Beyond multi-view 3D point tracking, our released annotations support monocular 2D and 3D point tracking, future-trajectory prediction, and 4D reconstruction.
summary_zh:
多相机系统在机器人、增强现实/虚拟现实及自动驾驶领域日益实用，因为互补视角能减少深度模糊性并在遮挡情况下保持可见性。然而，现有的点跟踪基准聚焦于单一视频或静态多相机装置，均未测试在相机运动条件下跨多个同步视图的长期3D点跟踪。我们提出TAPVid-MV（多视角视频任意点跟踪），这是该场景下的首个基准。其包含精心筛选的284个序列、1142个标定相机流及109,769个点轨迹，涵盖七个子集，跨越室内外领域，包括机器人、人类活动、驾驶及合成程序化场景。我们通过数据集特定的辅助模态获得这些轨迹：传感器深度、激光雷达、SLAM与SfM点、人体网格、带姿态物体网格及仿真。每个序列和轨迹均由人工标注者进行视觉验证。

在超过30个基线方法中，没有任何方法能接近解决该任务。出人意料的是，现有多视角点跟踪器的表现并未稳定优于单目点跟踪器。通过在相同数据集上评估重建与点跟踪，TAPVid-MV有助于区分几何恢复误差与点对应误差。通过这种联合分析，我们确定几何恢复是精确3D点跟踪的主要瓶颈。除多视角3D点跟踪外，我们发布的标注数据还支持单目2D与3D点跟踪、未来轨迹预测及4D重建。
tldr: Introduces a multi-view 3D point tracking benchmark for robotics, AR/VR, and autonomous driving, revealing geometry recovery as a key bottleneck.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个面向机器人、AR/VR和自动驾驶的多视角3D点跟踪基准，揭示了几何恢复是主要瓶颈。

title: An Adaptive Control Architecture for Slope and Terrain Compensation in Autonomous Navigation in Mediterranean Greenhouses
summary: The ability to move stably over terrain with varying slopes and textures is essential for mobile agricultural robots operating in complex and dynamic environments such as greenhouses, where small terrain irregularities can lead to significant navigation errors. This article presents a novel terrain-adaptation strategy based on the carried payload, ensuring accurate and robust trajectory tracking. The proposed approach is based on: (i) the experimental characterization of the most common types of greenhouse soil, concrete, compacted sand, and gravel, and (ii) the direct measurement of terrain slope using the IMU, in order to estimate the force with which this angle affects the motor input. Based on this information, a cascade trajectory-tracking scheme has been designed, consisting of a model-based predictive controller (MPC) in the outer loop and a PI controller in the inner loop. The system incorporates an adaptive feedforward control through gain scheduling approach, capable of adjusting to disturbances caused by variations in slope and terrain type. Simulation results demonstrate that the differential-drive robot achieves a significant improvement both in error indices and in control signal efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
tldr: A model-based predictive controller with adaptive feedforward gain scheduling compensates for slope and terrain variations in differential-drive agricultural robots, using IMU-based slope measurement and soil-specific characterization.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于模型预测控制与增益调度前馈的自适应地形补偿方法，利用IMU测量坡度和土壤特性表征，提升温室农业机器人轨迹跟踪精度。

title: From Multi-Fisheye Sensing to Panoramic Perception: A Parallax-Aware Onboard Platform for Ultra-Low-Altitude UAVs
summary: Ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) require surround vision near buildings, vegetation, and other obstacles. We present a parallax-aware onboard platform that converts four synchronized fisheye streams into an open 1280x640 equirectangular panorama (ERP) interface. A purpose-built carbon-fiber airframe integrates the cameras, NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, a flight controller, and a global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receiver. The formation pipeline selects projection depth per overlap and combines controlled seams and photometric fusion. Its accuracy profile adds content-adaptive seam search and a validation-gated residual mesh, whereas its deployed profile retains margin-gated Per-seam updates for sensor-rate operation. Evaluation uses more than 50,000 four-view groups from 18 field sequences. Relative to Fixed Depth, the accuracy profile reduces far-field P90 feature misalignment by 41.6%; the deployed Per-seam profile achieves the lowest aggregate geometric errors across held-out sites. Under a paced 20 Hz replay, the deployed profile sustains 19.99 frames/s at 13.29W mean module-input power. Eight-sector ERP sampling reaches 90.8% mean daytime visual-place-recognition Recall@5. Together, these results validate an integrated onboard panoramic-perception architecture that unifies parallax-aware formation, sensor-rate embedded execution, and reusable downstream vision interfaces for ultra-low-altitude UAVs. The project has been open-sourced at https://github.com/DUNDAI1998/parallax-aware-uav-panorama.
tldr: This paper presents a parallax-aware onboard platform that fuses multi-fisheye streams into a panoramic perception interface for ultra-low-altitude UAVs, achieving real-time embedded execution and improved visual-place-recognition accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种视差感知机载平台，将多鱼眼相机流融合为全景感知接口，用于超低空无人机，实现了实时嵌入式执行并提升了视觉地点识别精度。

title: Recursive Value Learning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
summary: Scaling offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) to long-horizon tasks is difficult because (1) long-range value learning depends on shorter-range estimates that may still be inaccurate, and (2) max-based value backups can amplify overestimation through repeated propagation. We propose DCRL (Divide-and-Conquer RL), which recursively decomposes each trajectory segment into a balanced binary tree and trains the values from leaves to root. Each parent is therefore updated only after its children, using an exact factorization of the observed route rather than selecting among noisy alternatives. Since this objective learns values along demonstrated routes that are not necessarily optimal, DCRL jointly propagates values across trajectories to discover shorter routes. Thanks to the balanced binary tree, DCRL reduces worst-case bootstrap depth from linear to logarithmic, and this shorter dependency structure empirically corresponds to much slower error accumulation. Across diverse goal-reaching tasks, DCRL substantially outperforms prior flat offline GCRL methods, and on the five most challenging long-horizon OGBench tasks, it improves the best prior average score from 55 to 64, surpassing all flat and hierarchical baselines.
tldr: Proposes DCRL, a recursive method that decomposes long-horizon offline goal-conditioned RL trajectories into binary trees to reduce value estimation error accumulation and improve long-horizon performance.
tldr_zh: 提出DCRL方法，通过递归地将长视野离线目标条件强化学习轨迹分解为二叉树来减少值估计误差累积，提升长视野任务性能。

title: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
summary: Autonomous robots powered by deep learning face a fundamental auditability challenge: when incidents occur, investigators cannot reconstruct why the system made specific decisions. This paper presents TRACE (Transparent Reasoning Architecture for Credible Execution), a decision framework that ensures every autonomous action can be traced back to sensor evidence through documented causal chains. The framework organizes decision-making into four auditable layers: Semantic Perception for evidence-grounded entity recognition, Belief Reasoning for probabilistic state estimation with causal graphs, Action Synthesis for constraint-aware planning with counterfactual documentation, and Execution Verification for compliance monitoring. TRACE is model-agnostic yet designed to integrate learning-based perception modules (CNNs, transformers) while preserving decision-level auditability. We evaluate the framework using three objective metrics: Evidence Traceability (sensor-to-decision linkage), Decision Reconstructability (post-hoc analysis capability), and Temporal Continuity (audit trail completeness). Experimental evaluation on warehouse robot navigation demonstrates that TRACE achieves 98.6% evidence traceability, 99.0% temporal continuity, and 98.1% decision reconstructability across 500 simulated decision cycles. Post-hoc methods like LIME provide feature attributions but lack the artifact structure needed for decision-level reconstruction. The framework addresses EU AI Act requirements for high-risk system transparency and contributes to Explainable AI for safety-critical autonomous systems.
tldr: This paper presents TRACE, a layered decision framework that ensures every autonomous robot action can be traced back to sensor evidence through documented causal chains, evaluated on warehouse robot navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TRACE，一种分层决策框架，确保自主机器人的每个动作都可以通过记录的因果链追溯到传感器证据，并在仓库机器人导航上进行了评估。

title: Towards Effective Physical Reservoir Computing with a Pneumatic Soft Robot
summary: Physical reservoir computing (PRC) refers to the use of a physical dynamical system as a computational resource for tasks such as state estimation and control, but there has been a lack of formal study of design rules towards more effective design of such physical reservoirs. Using a pneumatic soft arm with a five-pouch sensing column, this work studies how the pouch interconnection topology, robot stiffness, and the number of instrumented sensors affect bending-angle estimation performance. Across 36 matched trials spanning waveform, baseline pressure of the sensing column, and actuation range, all designs are evaluated under the same-time bending-angle estimation benchmark using 0.2 s of pressure history and a fixed ridge estimator. Our analysis of the experimental results leads to three design guidelines. First, independently sealed pouches preserve a much richer observable state than a shared manifold. Second, increasing the baseline pressure of the sensing column makes the pouch responses more redundant and increases estimation error most strongly in the coupled topology. Third, in the sealed topology, two strategically placed sensors already recover most of the attainable benefit, three capture essentially all of it, and additional sensors provide little or no additional value. In summary, the results suggest that topology, stiffness, and number of instrumented sensors should be co-designed for accurate PRC of soft robot states; stronger excitation alone cannot recover the diversity that poor design choices have already removed.
tldr: This paper investigates design guidelines for physical reservoir computing using a pneumatic soft robot arm, showing that pouch interconnection topology, stiffness, and sensor count significantly affect bending-angle estimation accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了使用气动软体机械臂进行物理储层计算的设计准则，发现气囊互联拓扑、刚度和传感器数量显著影响弯曲角度估计精度。

title: Belief-Calibrated Optimization: An Explicit World Model for Agentic Optimization
summary: The performance of an LLM agent depends on the scaffold around a frozen model. A common way to improve that scaffold is to use a coding agent as an optimizer: it reads current scores and traces and iteratively edits the source, producing a new candidate each round. Each edit is chosen according to a belief about how the environment will respond: what went wrong, and which change should help. That belief is typically implicit. It lives in the coding agent's reasoning on the current call, or remains latent in its parameters, rather than as something written down. Later calls therefore see scores and traces, but they do not use that belief. We introduce Belief-Calibrated Optimization (BCO), a method that writes that belief down as a persistent in-context document and continually revises that document as new candidates are evaluated. The resulting document is a world model: the current account of how the environment responds to edits. Added to an otherwise standard loop, BCO reaches a higher train passrate than a matched control that lacks only the world model, on five benchmarks spanning memory QA, tool-use QA, code-as-action app agents, and terminal agents. The gap remains on every held-out split, which is not used to select the candidate. After a target-model swap, in which the frozen model is replaced and the scaffold is not, the selected BCO scaffold leads on the tasks we test, except where context-window overruns leave it unfinished. An offline ablation then asks whether that gap comes from what the world model says. A fresh predictor given the accumulated document forecasts how the environment will respond more accurately than predictors given either no document or a same-form copy whose content has been falsified. The comparison indicates that the document carries reusable information in its content, not only in its form.
tldr: Belief-Calibrated Optimization (BCO) improves LLM agent scaffolds by writing persistent belief documents as explicit world models, outperforming controls on multiple agentic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 信念校准优化（BCO）通过将持续信念文档作为显式世界模型写入，改进了LLM智能体支架，在多个智能体基准上优于对照方法。

title: MV-dVRK: A Multi-Viewpoint Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
summary: Large-scale training and refined optimization techniques have greatly improved sparse multi-view 3D reconstruction. Despite their relevance to surgery, such methods have never before been rigorously evaluated on real endoscopic images. Current clinical telerobots deploy a single stereo camera inside the patient, making multi-viewpoint data extremely rare. This paper presents MV-dVRK, the first ex-vivo surgical dataset to combine multiple exposure-synchronized stereo viewpoints with accurate surface geometry and camera poses. The static subset of the benchmark provides dense SfM reference geometry, validated against an industrial 3D scanner, together with ground-truth camera poses and sparse-view test sets. We use MV-dVRK to systematically compare zero-shot monocular, stereo, multi-stereo, and multi-view 3D reconstruction methods as the number of viewpoints increases. With two endoscopes, multi-stereo reconstruction achieves the highest coverage. With a third viewpoint, optimization-based multi-view methods perform best, covering 67% of ground-truth surface points within a 1 mm tolerance and recovering highly accurate relative camera poses. By contrast, feed-forward foundation models cover only 43% of the ground-truth surface in the same setting. MV-dVRK also includes ten dynamic sequences spanning multiple surgical tasks, with increasing kinematic complexity and tissue deformation, providing a basis for future research in multi-viewpoint surgical perception. The project is available at: https://mv-dvrk.is.mpg.de.
tldr: Introduces a multi-viewpoint endoscopic surgical dataset with synchronized stereo views and ground-truth geometry, enabling systematic evaluation of 3D reconstruction methods in a surgical setting.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个多视角内窥镜手术数据集，包含同步立体视图和真实几何数据，用于系统评估手术场景中的3D重建方法。

title: Advancing Accessible Underwater Robotics: The Mini-Girona I-AUV at RAMI 2025
summary: The Mini-Girona Intervention Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (I-AUV) represents an advancement in accessible underwater robotics, designed to bridge the gap between costly, specialized research AUVs and basic Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs). Developed with a focus on affordability and usability, the Mini-Girona, priced at approximately $50,000, integrates advanced components such as a 5-DOF manipulator arm, stereo vision, and AI-driven processing for autonomous navigation and intervention tasks. This paper presents the design and development of the Mini-Girona, detailing its performance during the RAMI 2025 student competition. Despite challenges such as thermal management issues and restricted team access, the Mini-Girona achieved second place overall, excelling in vision-based perception and intervention tasks. This work highlights the platform's potential as a tool for underwater robotics research and education, fostering innovation in real-world underwater applications.
tldr: Presents the Mini-Girona I-AUV, an affordable ($50k) underwater robot with a 5-DOF arm, stereo vision, and AI-driven autonomy, validated at the RAMI 2025 competition.
tldr_zh: 介绍Mini-Girona I-AUV，一款价格亲民（约5万美元）的水下机器人，配备5自由度机械臂、立体视觉和AI自主能力，在RAMI 2025竞赛中得到验证。

title: WildFab: Multi-Axis 3D Printing from Models in the Wild
summary: Multi-axis 3D printing enables support-free fabrication and improved part quality, but robustly processing real-world geometries remains challenging. Models from design workflows or direct data acquisition often contain solid--shell combinations and non-manifold structures. Handling such models in the wild typically requires time-consuming geometry repair, which may alter the intended geometry. In this work, we present WildFab, a computational framework for multi-axis 3D printing that directly computes spatial toolpath and global collision-free motion from input models. Our pipeline builds on a hybrid query representation that combines a neural unsigned distance field (UDF) with a regularized generalized winding number field (reg-GWN). The UDF supplies differentiable surface-distance and direction queries, while the reg-GWN resolves near-surface ambiguity in the fitted UDF by providing reliable surface localization and a solid-void indicator. Based on this representation, we introduce a high-precision spatial toolpath computation algorithm that iteratively projects points between optimized guidance-field level sets and reg-GWN gradient-magnitude ridges. Subsequently, we develop an efficient and robust coarse-to-fine collision checking scheme for motion planning: UDF-based rejection first identifies potential collisions, while time-varying reg-GWN verification accurately resolves collision pairs for both solid and shell components. We validate WildFab on diverse inputs, demonstrating successful computation from non-manifold parametric surfaces, voxelized topology-optimization results, implicit models, raw scanned point clouds, and non-watertight meshes. The fabrication results highlight our method's ability to advance end-to-end design-to-3DP workflows.
tldr: WildFab is a computational framework for multi-axis 3D printing that processes raw, non-watertight models from the wild without requiring geometry repair, using a hybrid neural unsigned distance field and regularized generalized winding number field.
tldr_zh: WildFab 是一个用于多轴 3D 打印的计算框架，它利用混合神经无符号距离场和正则化广义绕数场，无需几何修复即可直接从非水密模型生成空间刀具路径和全局无碰撞运动。

title: Koopman-Based Robust Model Predictive Control for Nonlinear Systems with Stochastic Intermittent Measurements
summary: Intermittent state measurements pose fundamental challenges to model predictive control of constrained nonlinear systems because prediction uncertainty grows during feedback outages and measurement-triggered resets disrupt nominal state propagation, potentially compromising closed-loop stability and recursive feasibility. This paper develops a Koopman-based stochastic MPC framework with probabilistically truncated soft constraints. Specifically, a Lipschitz-constrained deep Koopman model provides a linear latent predictor, enabling computationally efficient online optimization. The intermittent measurement process is modeled as a two-mode discrete-time Markov chain, yielding a unified Markov jump error model for open-loop propagation and measurement-triggered resets. Under numerically verifiable sufficient conditions, the prediction error is shown to be mean-square ultimately bounded, and an explicit uniform second-moment bound is obtained. A distribution-free probabilistic error radius is then constructed for a prescribed confidence level and used to truncate dropout-dependent constraint tightening. An exact-penalty soft-constraint mechanism accommodates reset-induced jumps and prolonged dropouts. Under the stated terminal compatibility and bounded-disturbance conditions, recursive feasibility and mean-square ultimate boundedness of the closed-loop regulation error are established. Numerical simulations on a visual-servoing tracking task corroborate these theoretical results and demonstrate effective tracking under stochastic measurement unavailability.
tldr: A Koopman-based robust MPC framework for nonlinear systems with stochastic intermittent measurements, using a Lipschitz-constrained deep Koopman model for linear prediction and a probabilistic constraint-tightening scheme.
tldr_zh: 针对随机间歇测量下的非线性系统，提出基于Koopman的鲁棒MPC框架，利用Lipschitz约束深度Koopman模型进行线性预测，并采用概率约束紧缩方案。
